findings.message: Unsupported: There is no condition for "you cast it any time a sorcery couldn't have been cast" and no way to set up, at cast time, a delayed sacrifice at the next cleanup step by the controller of the permanent the spell becomes.
Unsupported: No ObjectFilter can describe "a creature put onto the battlefield with Necromancy", so the enchant ability the permanent gains when it becomes an Aura cannot be spelled.
